title: LLM Call Pattern
description: Sends a prompt to an LLM and stores the response in graph state. Supports input_mapping to build the LLM request from state variables and output_mapping to write LLM output back into state.

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt prepended to every request

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the LLM response. Default: 2048

input_mapping.description: Maps graph state paths to LLM message roles. Supported source paths: state.variables.<name> (reads a state variable), state.messages[-1].content (reads the last message content). Each key becomes the user message content.

output_mapping.description: Maps LLM output fields to graph state variables. Supported source fields: output.content (generated text), output.stop_reason (end_turn|tool_use|max_tokens). Target must be state.variables.<name>. If omitted, defaults to {"response": output.content}.
